resources.string: +15% damage, +8% attack speed; focus wounded frontline enemies. Take +10% damage.
Take 15% less damage; +15% healing and a starting shield for the front row. Deal 10% less damage. Automatic support ultimates wait for injuries or a boss warning.
Skills recharge 20% faster; stuns last 35% longer. Ranged attackers prioritize enemy casters. Deal 5% less damage.
STN: cannot act. PSN: damage over time. ATK+: +20% attack. ATK−: −20% attack. Boss attacks show their targets for 1.5 seconds; shields absorb the impact and stuns delay it.
No terrain modifier. Learn formations, factions and boss warnings here.
Every 8 seconds, unstunned guardians, healers, bards and engineers shield their most injured ally for 1.5 × their attack. Both sides follow this rule.
Enemies gain 25 armour. Mages and engineers ignore this extra plating; armour penetration also helps.
After 20 seconds, attacks on both sides gain 1% damage per second, up to +15%. Burst damage and timely shields shorten dangerous fights.
Every 10 seconds, all combatants take venom for 4 seconds: 0.6% of their maximum health per second, bypassing shields. Purify clears this venom. Healing and defensive tactics help.
Ordinary attacks recharge 12% slower for both sides. Skills and ultimates recharge normally. Casters and the Control tactic keep their rhythm.
